info.name: DrawSpace Backend API
info.description:
REST collection for the DrawSpace backend (real-time multiplayer infinite drawing playground).

**Run order:**
1. Start the backend (`docker compose up -d` then `mvn spring-boot:run`, see README).
2. Run **Rooms → Create room** — the test script stores `roomCode`, `participantId`, `participantToken` and `drawingId` into collection variables.
3. Run **Rooms → Join room** with a second browser profile in mind — the script stores the *joiner's* identity (overwriting the creator's `participantId`/`participantToken`). Re-run Create room to get a fresh owner identity.
4. The drawing endpoints use `{{drawingId}}` from the create response.

WebSocket endpoints cannot be driven from this collection — see the **"WebSocket testing note"** request for the STOMP/SockJS details (destination list per CONTRACT §4).

request.description: Creates a room + drawing, assigns the creator a palette color (§2) and returns the identity `{roomCode, roomTitle, drawingId, participantId, participantToken, displayName, color, maxParticipants}` (201). Validation: `displayName` 2–24 chars (400 on violation).

// NOTE: this OVERWRITES the creator identity with the joiner's —

request.description: Joins an existing room. Concurrency-safe capacity check (2–5 participants, room row locked before counting, §10). Errors: 404 unknown code, 409 room full, 410 expired/inactive. Response = create response + `participants: [ParticipantResponse]`.
Public room projection (§3 #3): `{roomCode, title, drawingId, ownerParticipantId, maxParticipants, activeParticipantCount, isActive, createdAt}`. 404 for unknown codes.
Lists room participants (§3 #4): `[{participantId, displayName, color, isOwner, online, joinedAt}]`. `online` = not left and last heartbeat within the stale threshold.

Privileged action (§3 #5): identity + token verified server-side. 204 on success. If the owner leaves, ownership transfers to the earliest-joined remaining active participant and an OWNER_CHANGED event is broadcast on `/topic/room/{code}/events`. Errors: 403 bad token / not enrolled, 404 unknown room.
Owner-only privileged action (§3 #10): persists a CLEAR event through the standard save pipeline (§6) so it is replayable and undoable. 204 on success; 403 for non-owners or bad tokens.

item.name: Drawings
item.description: Drawing projections, contributor stats, event history and snapshots (CONTRACT §3 #6–#9). All read-only.

request.description: Drawing metadata (§3 #6): `{drawingId, title, roomCode, createdByParticipantId, creatorDisplayName, createdAt, updatedAt, totalOperations, contributorCount}`. 404 for unknown ids.

Contributor statistics (§3 #7): `{drawingId, totalOperations, contributors:[{participantId, displayName, color, firstContributedAt, lastContributedAt, totalOperations, toolsUsed:[string]}]}`. Counts are activity statistics, not effort measures.

query.description: Return events with sequenceNumber > afterSequence (client replay cursor, §13)

request.description: Event log page (§3 #8): `{drawingId, lastSequence, hasMore, events:[{eventId, participantId, displayName, sequenceNumber, eventType, eventData, createdAt}]}` ascending by sequenceNumber. Clients loop with `afterSequence = lastSequence` until `hasMore = false`.

Latest canonical snapshot (§3 #9 / §9): 200 `{drawingId, sequenceNumber, snapshotData, createdAt}` or 404 when none exists yet (empty state, default "Layer 1"). `snapshotData` = `{canvasBg, layers, objects (live only), lastSequence}`.

**This is not a real API call** — it pings `/actuator/health` so the note is runnable; the actual content below explains how to test the WebSocket layer (CONTRACT §4), which Postman's REST client cannot drive.

## Endpoint
`/ws-drawspace` — STOMP over WebSocket, **SockJS enabled** (fallback transports). Connect from the frontend origin (CORS/SockJS origin allow-list comes from `CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS`).

## STOMP CONNECT headers
Native headers on CONNECT:
- `Authorization: Bearer <participantToken>` (UUID issued by create/join)
- `X-Room-Code: <roomCode>`

The backend interceptor validates room + token, sets the STOMP Principal name = `participantId`, and stores the room code in the session. Every SEND must target the CONNECTed room. Failure rejects the CONNECT (no principal → handlers answer on `/user/queue/errors`).

## Publish destinations (client → server, prefix `/app`)
| Destination | Payload |
|---|---|
| `/app/room/{code}/draw` | `DrawingOperationMessage` (CONTRACT §7) |
| `/app/room/{code}/cursor` | `{x, y}` world coords (relay only, never persisted) |
| `/app/room/{code}/undo` | `{eventId, targetEventId}` |
| `/app/room/{code}/redo` | `{eventId, targetEventId}` (target = the UNDO event's id) |
| `/app/room/{code}/clear` | `{eventId}` |
| `/app/room/{code}/presence` | `{status: "ACTIVE"}` heartbeat every ~25 s |
| `/app/room/{code}/viewport` | `{x, y, zoom, width, height}` (minimap indicator only, never persisted) |

## Subscribe topics (server → client)
| Topic | Payload |
|---|---|
| `/topic/room/{code}/draw` | accepted op enriched with `participantId, displayName, participantColor, sequenceNumber, serverTimestamp` |
| `/topic/room/{code}/cursor` | `{participantId, displayName, color, x, y}` (not persisted) |
| `/topic/room/{code}/participants` | full `[ParticipantResponse]` after join/leave/disconnect/cleanup |
| `/topic/room/{code}/events` | `{type: "PARTICIPANT_JOINED"\|"PARTICIPANT_LEFT"\|"OWNER_CHANGED"\|"SNAPSHOT_SAVED", participantId?, displayName?, message, timestamp}` |
| `/topic/room/{code}/viewport` | `{participantId, displayName, color, x, y, zoom, width, height}` |
| `/topic/room/{code}/canvas` | `{type: "SNAPSHOT_CREATED", sequenceNumber}` |
| `/user/queue/ack` | `{eventId, sequenceNumber, status: "SAVED"}` (per-participant ack) |
| `/user/queue/errors` | `{eventId?, message}` |

## How to test manually
1. Create/join a room via this collection to mint `participantToken` + `roomCode`.
2. Use a STOMP client (e.g. `stompjs` + `sockjs-client` in a scratch HTML page, or `websocat` against the raw WebSocket transport) with the CONNECT headers above.
3. Publish a BRUSH_STROKE to `/app/room/{code}/draw`; expect the enriched copy on `/topic/room/{code}/draw` and `{eventId, sequenceNumber, status: "SAVED"}` on `/user/queue/ack`.
4. Re-sending the same `eventId` must NOT re-broadcast (idempotent dedupe, §6) but still acks the existing sequence.
5. Open two browser windows to observe multi-participant cursor/presence/participants traffic.
